detailed_description: 2D-animated. Modern high-end Japanese anime game key visual: crisp thin lineart, dramatic cel shading with hard-edged shadows, strong rim light, glowing bloom, deep saturated color. [Shot 1] Total darkness at night, only the settler woman in a linen coif's two hands in the frame, in rolled brown wool sleeves, held up in the air at chest height against the dark night, the sand far below and out of focus. Her left hand at frame left holds the grey flint chip with its sharp edge pointing toward frame right; a palm-sized square of black char cloth with pinked edges is laid flat on top of the flint, on the side facing the camera, covering most of the flint so the black cloth is the nearest, largest thing in her hand, her thumb pressing it down onto the stone, only the flint's sharp grey edge sticking out from under the cloth at its right side. Her right hand at frame right wears the C-shaped steel striker like a knuckle-duster: her four fingers pass through the open inside of the C from behind, so the C's curved back lies flat across the front of her curled fingers, facing the flint, and its two spiral ends rest against the back of her hand on either side; the striker is small, no wider than her palm, raised a few centimetres above and to the right of the flint's exposed edge, ready to scrape down across it. Both hands are faintly rim-lit in deep blue, the only light in the frame.
